reviews.text:
I reached out to Matty as my puppy was showing some concerning behaviours with other dogs and struggle it with separation. I got custom, hands on guidance tailored to me and my dog, and saw improvement within a few weeks! As my dog is young, Matty was great at adapting the training along side her development, and gave me lots of resources and reassurance throughout the process.

Ponyo has gone from being scared and barking at other dogs to being so excited and just wanting to play over a few months. I’d highly recommend working with Matty if you need support with your pup.

We purchased the Ultimate Support package and we could not be happier with the results.

Our beloved rescue terr(or)ier has struggled with some health issues and is so much happier and calmer since sessions with Matty and we have so much more confidence in preventing his triggers and keeping him calm in any situation.

I would describe him as a completely different dog now, and our stress levels as a family have dramatically decreased.

Matty provided us with clear exercises to work through at a good pace and helpful videos to keep referring to - and then in person sessions which were great to cement learning.

She was on hand (whatsapp) for advice, and provided great recommendations as situations arose.

Indy has even started making friends with other dogs which nine months ago was unthinkable.

It's an ongoing journey but we could not have gotten here without Matty's support, and Indy loves and trusts her too, which is really the best recommendation.

Your pet insurance might even cover the cost where there are underlying health conditions.

We purchased the 8 month training course with Matty and it has definitely been a success. Our dog Buddy is a Romanian rescue, and he finds London life challenging.

Since working with Matty he is a happier dog, more confident and tolerating London traffic better.

Our training course has now come to an end, but we will be continuing with Matty to help
Buddy to be the best version of himself.

I recommend Matty, she is very professional, and has a wealth of knowledge. Buddy also enjoyed her visits 😊
Matty gave us some great tools to help us get our terrier, Billie, ready for life with a baby. Thank you!

We sought Matty's help to address serious problems with out beloved greyhound, who had become too much for us to handle. Our dog was snapping and lunging at us quite often. It had become difficult even to put her harness on for walks.

After going through the Beyond Reactivity course, we're now able to take our dog out for walks every day, and are no longer nervous around her. Matty has a calm and reassuring manner, and takes an incremental approach which worked very well for us. She also prioritises safety so that we felt comfortable with the training at all times.

If you are having problems with your dog we would strongly recommend contacting Beyond Reactivity.

We were having issues with our very anxious dog and was at a loss of what to do to help him, matty from beyond reactivity really helped us to understand what our dog was going through and gave us guidance throughout our time with beyond that made such a big difference with our dogs behavior  and helped build his confidence up. Would definitely recommend!

Matty has been instrumental in the change of behaviour of our rescue dog Pluto. From day one we felt she understood the challenges we were facing (not knowing much about Pluto's past being the biggest point). She set us on a path where we all,dog and humans,  could feel safer sharing a space. He can be aggressive and bite when scared or when guarding food or toys. Thanks to Matty and her programme, sessions and resources, we are more confident identifying triggers and putting in practice strategies for him to relax and for us to be the best owners for him. He is a happy dog and we are so happy to have worked with Matty.

We first asked Matty back in October 2024 to help us with our very anxious bull terrier, Lily. Our dog, who was once incredibly social and loved her walks started to become reluctant and increasingly scared and distressed about being taken outside. She was also becoming depressed inside the house.

Not knowing any specific reason for this anxiety made Matty’s job difficult but on our first meeting, it was clear she was determined to make things better. Advice was given on ACE training to stimulate, distract and motivate Lily and noise tolerance training to desensitise her from sudden noises. She also suggested that we see our vet about putting Lily on anxiety medication. Together, the training and medication started to make a difference. Lily’s apathy inside the house started to decrease and her interest in taking a peek outside the front door started to grow. She slowly started to take walks again.

Lily has peaks and troughs with her confidence and will probably continue to do so. However, Matty has equipped us with a tool box to understand and support our dog. We enjoy the days she wants to go for a walk and race around and don’t stress as much any more on the days that she doesn’t.

Matty was warm, approachable and very understanding. She was particularly sympathetic on days when it all felt a bit too much. The Beyond Reactivity website was easy to access all our specific courses and the WhatsApp group was a real support.

We’ve had a fantastic experience working with our dog behaviourist. She is incredibly attentive, always punctual, and clearly passionate about helping dogs (and their humans!) thrive. Her guidance has been both practical and insightful — every session left us feeling more confident and better equipped to support our dog.

One of the things I really appreciate is the app she uses to track progress. It’s easy to navigate and makes it simple to find notes from calls, meeting summaries, and all the advice she’s shared. It’s been such a helpful tool to stay organized and consistent between sessions.

Highly recommend her to anyone looking for professional, thoughtful, and effective behaviour support for their dog.

Matti was excellent at helping our family (1 toddler and 1 whippet) to create safe boundaries in the home.  She also massively helped with our dog Bobbi’s anxiety around other dogs and introduced plans and safety measures for having her in more social settings.  She has helped us keep our family together.  Thank you Matti

We came across Beyond Reactivity after a visit to the vet, following their recommendation to see a dog behaviorist regarding our dog Moka's discomfort, fear, and trauma issues—specifically with motorbikes and unknown dogs.

We worked with Matty (Founder of Beyond Reactivity) for 6 months, both in-person and online. Matty was very kind and patient, listened attentively, and read our long reports and journal entries.

Moka's behavior has improved significantly, and we have learned more about our dog's needs and how to fulfill them through various exercises recommended specifically for Moka.

Top 6 things that we learned:

1.) Patience, love, and consistency go a long way.

2.) Your dog communicates with you all the time—learn to read them.

3.) Boundaries are important.

4.) Independence is important.

5.) Points 2-4 help build their confidence.

6.) Strengthen your relationship through play, rest, and exposure to neutral/positive environments.

We have recommended Beyond Reactivity to neighbors and friends since starting, as we are very happy with the results.

We are so grateful to Matty, and we will ensure we stay consistent with meeting Moka's needs to ensure her happiness.

Unfortunately, working with Matty didn't work for me and my dog, but I can't fault Matty's dedication to trying to help us. She was extremely thorough and patient, taking a full history of my dog's life, and looked at everything from her health to her environment to try and find the source of, and solution to, her reactivity.
In the end, we had to switch to another trainer with different methods to achieve the results we needed, but we definitely built some foundational skills through working with Matty which were helpful in our subsequent training.

Working with Matty has been transformative for our Dachshund. Our pup has suffered from anxiety and reactivity since adolescence, with unclear and confusing triggers. He was exhibiting increasing signs of reactivity, so we felt we needed the expertise of an accredited professional.  After the first session, we immediately felt comfortable that we were in safe hands. Matty went through our pup's entire history, every incident he ever had, and examined his current behaviour.
Matty immediately gave us concrete things to do to help manage and de-escalate his heightened stress, and we saw and immediate improvement.
After 6 months of working with Matty, our pup is a changed dog. He is a sensitive soul, and we now understand him and his feelings so much better.
He has always been loving, but now his positive traits have been amplified over his behavioural issues, and we are so much more comfortable taking him on walks and having people over. He is generally so much happier, and we are far less stressed out pet parents.

The course with Matty has been brilliant for our dog, Loki. He struggles with anxiety, but with Matty’s help and guidance, we’ve seen a huge improvement. Matty puts your dog’s wellbeing first and is so caring. Everything was explained clearly and taken at Loki’s pace, which made such a difference. The regular Zoom and WhatsApp check-ins, along with in-person sessions, ensured we made lots of progress. Loki is so much happier now, and so are we! Thank you so much 😊

My dog was struggling with leash reactivity towards all kinds of dogs, both big and small over the course of a year. He showed this by lunging and growling at dogs, even at dogs across the road. I was fortunate to find Matty and she provided in-depth advice and guidance on how to tackle this issue over 6 months. This came in the form of videos on her online portal as well as tailored training tips/relaxation methods for my dog. All training methods were based around positive reinforcement and/or aimed at improving my dog's overall mental wellbeing! In addition, her in-person consultations were invaluable. She also quickly identified a dietary issue that was heightening my dog's reactivity dramatically. Working with Matty over these last 6 months to address these issues has resulted in my dog exhibiting substantially less reactivity! He is now able to interact with other dogs whilst on the leash without lunging/growling which I thought would be impossible this time last year. If you are struggling with a reactive dog, I recommend getting in touch with Matty - if you are willing to put in the work, she is there to help you!

Matty has been incredibly helpful with our dog and very considerate and clear when showing my partner and I how to behave with our little one. Fast forward now, and out dog is walking comfortably loose leash and can relax when his family are at the cafe or other busy public places.

thanks !

I cannot recommend Matty, highly enough! From our very first session, Matty put both us and our dog at ease. her approach is not only professional and knowledgeable but also incredibly compassionate.
With her clear instructions and patience made it easy for me to continue reinforcing the training at home.
The transformation has been remarkable, we wished we met Matty earlier in our dog’s training journey.

We had an excellent experience with Matty. She helped us address and make substantial progress with two specific behavioural issues our dog faced.

Matty provided good in person support, as well as a wealth of follow up and online content and advice.

We will definitely use Matty again and have already noted significant improvements in our dogs behaviour.

Matty has been invaluable in helping us better manage our dog Ruby's anxiety, triggers and how to help her enjoy life more, particularly as she adjusts to our new baby. We particularly appreciated how responsive and pragmatic Matty was, and the online resources made available for us to revisit in between sessions. Would high recommend, particularly for families managing a dog with young children. Thanks Matty!

We first got in contact with Matty when out puppy Ivy was around 12 weeks old. We wanted some guidance on house training & lead walking. Matty was fantastic from the get go. She introduced us to certain commands and taught us the correct body language to use when Ivy was going through her nippy stage.
She has given myself and my mum to confidence to understand Ivy's needs. We are continuing to reinforce the commands and Ivy is grown with knowledge.
